items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: He's currently been working with Barry Harris, Charles McPherson, and the next job we have, Pat Patrick had to leave, so we got Paul Jeffries.

ctx.x: up close, but he come in and he saw me come right down in front, he was a powerful little cat, just picked me up bodily and just -- oh, (unintelligible), you George Duvivier know, glad to see me and I was happy to see him -- (inaudible), cats like that.

Anyway, we get back to New York and Thelonius let Beaver people go. So he asked me to get a drummer and I got Leroy Williams, another home drummer. He's currently been working with Barry Harris, Charles McPherson, and the next job we have, Pat Patrick had to leave, so we got Paul Jeffries. We played Raleigh, North Carolina. We come back from Raleigh and played the Vanguard and that was the last gig I played with Thelonius. No, we played one gig down in Chinatown, New York, little concert for one of them Chinese…
But that was about the last gig I had with Thelonius.
